DECISION — Doc GDM-STD-2028-02, effective 2028-03-01.

Google DeepMind convenes the Frontier Evaluation Standards Table: OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, xAI, DeepSeek and Alibaba Qwen invited; UK AISI, EU AI Office and US NIST as observers.

First deliverable, draft in 90 days: a common incident taxonomy and a single evaluator audit-log schema. Technology-neutral by design, so no lab's stack becomes the required one and no lab gets to grade its own homework.

Consistent with the same commitment, Gemini 4 Argon pre-release evaluator access continues for UK AISI and the EU AI Office under a 72-hour incident clause. We are asking others to adopt the same clause, not a bespoke one. Pacing is right; the interoperable middle is what is missing.

DECISION — Doc QWEN-DEC-2028-01, effective 2028-03-01:

1) Qwen3.9-72B open weights released under Apache 2.0 — downloadable day one, no gate, no waitlist.
2) Evaluator access GRANTED under our published access terms to UK AISI, EU AI Office, and China CAC-registered evaluators, per applicable national rules in each jurisdiction.
3) Evaluator API keys + our 48-hour incident notification clause, standard for all access partners.

We stay inside the rules of every market we serve, and we keep the default open. Safety through transparency in the weights, not through a permission slip.

Model card and download counts in the thread. Build something good 🚀
